authoritative_admission.comparison: canonical JSON semantic equality of the complete objects; no selected-field substitute

pre_submit_rules: Recompute closure from original SQLite actions/evidence/locks before final dispatch.
A never-dispatched cancellation closes only execution=not_dispatched, dispatch_epoch=null, effect=settled_not_applied.
A dispatched unknown action cannot close or be excluded because public business state looks correct.
Bind original target identities, ledger epoch/guard, operation/source manifests and exact request/response digests.

controller_sections.evaluation_readiness: Exact pre-submit admission object, null if not obtained.
controller_sections.execution_integrity: Controller boundary status verified/unqualified/unknown; true execution errors are unqualified even if a raw original evaluation is retained. Independent host artifact/protocol/cleanup review remains pending.
controller_sections.public_business_snapshot: Observed public business state; status pass/known_fail/incomplete, accepted/missing/duplicates/wrong/unattributed, issue and service/queue/DB states, handles and incompleteness reasons.
controller_sections.additional_assurance: Historical proof status qualified/unqualified/unknown/not_evaluated; retained diagnostics, unknown intents and immutable owned-terminal/snapshot records; never used as original-score gate.
controller_sections.original_evaluation: Request status and count only; raw_mitigation_success=null in agent output. Original host owns the result.
controller_sections.already_accepted_intent_skips: Real permanent public-acceptance records bound to current attempt scope/ledger and exact public receipt/semantic intent; evidence ID/capture and payload SHA retained. Skip suppresses work only, with no lock change or causal/no-duplicate claim.

post_submit_pending.allowed: Exactly one original final_submit, action_id/attempt_id/native_call_id/response_sha256/state/submission_state match reread original acceptance evidence and raw files.
post_submit_pending.not_allowed: Any other read/write, wrong receipt, second final, reserved final or unknown original submission.

result_columns.name: raw_original_success
result_columns.source: unchanged original host Mitigation.success; preserve false and null exactly

result_columns.name: public_snapshot_status
result_columns.source: controller public_business_snapshot plus original public captures

result_columns.name: historical_terminal_status
result_columns.source: actual additional_assurance, no promotion of not-required to true

result_columns.name: qualified_original_success
result_columns.value: true|false|null; null while independent review is pending
result_columns.source: original raw true AND all nonhistorical protocol/source/execution/artifact/cleanup criteria; keep raw result even when unqualified

errors.known_failure_reason: Explicit KnownBusinessFailure from verified complete public observations, including complete-audit wrong/duplicate/unattributed delivery; distinct from execution error. Ordinary known_fail final checks also have error=null.
errors.error: Unmatched evidence/capability/transport/capture failures, never erased because snapshot contains missing notifications.
errors.final_admission_error: Original final precondition failure, retained independently.

denominators.started: all attempts with original incident visibility; do not drop abstentions, known failures, errors or timeouts
denominators.evaluated: subset with unique completed original evaluation
denominators.raw_successes: count raw true over all started plus evaluated-only descriptive rate
denominators.qualified_successes: count raw true with all nonhistorical qualification checks over all started
denominators.additional_assurance: separate distribution over all started; no hidden denominator removal

time.success: original first visibility to unique original evaluation completion only
time.not_evaluated: completion time null; retain elapsed stop/censor time and reason
time.budgets: New prelaunch B0-P ceilings: 7200s and 30000 native calls, 4096 ledger checks, 8 sends/intent, 4CPU/8GiB. Future compared arms share these ceilings; no existing attempt clock is reset.
